summary: Magnum Ice Cream Co N.V. filed a Form 6-K containing a stock exchange announcement under the EU/UK Market Abuse Regulation, reporting routine acquisitions of ordinary shares by PDMRs (including the CEO and other officers). The transactions were open-market purchases at prevailing prices (€13.745-€14.092 on XAMS, $16.38 on NYSE). No board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms are noted. This is a routine director/PDMR shareholding notification with no special-situation characteristics; it is equivalent to a U.S. Form 4 filing.
